title: What If Saitama Trained You for 1 Year?
tags: what if you did the saitama workout
what if you got stronger every day
description:
The mountain above your town is cracking, and it comes down in one year. The only person offering to help is a hot dog vendor who says he is the hero from the anime. He is not. But he punched the mountain next door out of existence, so you take the list: 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, 10 km. Every day. And every day you finish, you get 5% stronger.

Two questions for the comments:
1) Which day would you have quit on?
2) One year of the list for that kind of strength: yes or no?

If you would have done the hundred, subscribe.


Real facts in this episode:

• Losing 50 to 100 hairs a day is completely normal (American Academy of Dermatology).
https://aad.org/hair-shedding

• The heaviest deadlift ever recorded was 501 kg when Hafthor Bjornsson pulled it in 2020. He has since raised it to 510 kg (Guinness World Records, 2025).
https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/heaviest-deadlift.html

• In 2023 the Swiss village of Brienz was evacuated because the mountain above it was sliding. A month later about 1.2 million cubic meters of rock came down in one night and stopped just short of the village.
https://www.cbc.ca/radio/asithappens/brienz-swiss-rock-slide-1.6879340

• To leave the Earth for good you need about 11.2 km per second (escape velocity).
https://qrg.northwestern.edu/projects/vss/docs/space-environment/2-whats-escape-velocity.html

• Sound travels at about 1,225 km/h at sea level.

• The International Space Station orbits about 400 km above the ground.

• Ordinary concrete crushes at roughly 300 times atmospheric pressure.

#whatif #gusmaybe #saitama #onepunchman #workout
